prompts.title: A week of posts from one shoot
prompts.summary: Seven captions and a posting order from the photos you took in one 20-minute session.
prompts.prompt: I shot these at [coffee shop] today: [list the photos or clips]. Write seven captions for this week, one a day, in this voice: [paste a caption you like]. Mix: one drink, one person behind the bar, one regular moment, one pastry, one hours or location post, one seasonal tease, one thank-you. Keep each under 40 words, no hashtag walls.
prompts.use: Shoot Monday morning before the rush. Schedule all seven at once.

prompts.title: Seasonal drink launch
prompts.summary: The post, the story frames and the counter sign for a new seasonal drink.
prompts.prompt: We're launching [drink] on [date] at [coffee shop]. What's in it: [ ]. Price: [ ]. Write: the launch post caption, three story frames (tease, first pour, last call), and the counter sign (eight words at most plus the price).
prompts.use: Post the tease three days before. Print the sign.

prompts.title: Review ask that follows the rules
prompts.summary: A card and a short message asking regulars for a Google review, with no reward offered.
prompts.prompt: Write a small card for the counter and a two-line text for regulars asking for a Google review of [coffee shop]. Rules: no discount, freebie or reward for a review, ask everyone (not only happy customers), and include the link [link]. Warm and short.
prompts.use: Put the card by the register. Never trade a drink for a review.
